Emma (eng-platform): heads-up — after the metering rfc merge i wanted to surface a few open questions about auditability and late attribution corrections.
Raj (eng-platform): thanks. which questions specifically?
Emma (eng-platform): primarily two things: 1) do we keep raw token events in cold storage forever (costly) or pre-aggregate into per-request billing events + provenance pointers? 2) how do we model corrections when attribution arrives late (up to 72h).
Olivia (eng-platform): my take: keep raw events for N days (30?), store compact provenance pointers after that. audits reference both when available. :thinking_face:
Mike (eng-platform): +1 for limited retention. we should ensure a deterministic reconciliation pipeline — e.g., final_invoice = sum(billing_events) + apply(corrections_log)
Emma (eng-platform): thinking about schema change too. example minimal billing_event:
```
{ "request_id": "uuid", "model": "gpt-redwood-4x", "tokens": 345, "attribution": "acct_123", "ingest_time": 1680000000 }
```
Raj (eng-platform): can we attach a provenance pointer to each billing_event that references an append-only audit stream id? that would let us reconstruct if we still have the audit shard.
Olivia (eng-platform): yep. provenance pointer = (audit_stream, offset, checksum). small and replayable.
Mike (eng-platform): tradeoff: querying many pointers for a customer audit is expensive. we should also maintain periodic rollups per-account with cursors to speed queries.
Emma (eng-platform): what about late attribution merging? options: mutate historical billing_events (hard), create correction_event that references billing_event and deltas (append-only).
Raj (eng-platform): prefer append-only correction_events. makes audits simpler and replay deterministic. plus we can mark correction out as 'finalized' once reconciliation passes.
ops-bot: deploy queued: metering-worker v2 -> staging at build 2203 :rocket:
Sarah (devex): also consider exposing a read-only audit API that returns the reconstructed stream for a given account/time-window. that would help finance and SOC.
Emma (eng-platform): action items: (1) raj to draft correction_event schema, (2) olivia to propose retention policy + cold-store format, (3) mike to outline rollup cursor design. aiming for RFC follow-up by EOW. :thumbsup:
Raj (eng-platform): on it. will post a short prod-proof-of-concept gist.
Olivia (eng-platform): will sketch retention numbers and estimated S3 cost.
Mike (eng-platform): i'll mock a rollup proto and perf numbers.
Emma (eng-platform): thanks team. moving this to #eng-platform for visibility; ping if you need infra quotas.
